newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil to unveil telcom watchdog bill in October.
newsitem.headline: Brazil to unveil telcom watchdog bill in October.

text.p: A draft version of bill creating a regulatory body for the Brazilian telecomuncations industry will be sent to Congress by the end of October, Communications Minister Sergio Motta said.

The bill will grant the new regulator full independence from political interference, with all revenues raised from licensing of communications concessions being administered by the body, Motta told reporters.
Also included in the bill will be other rules and regulations for private players in the communications sector, the minister said.

Congress approved last year the opening up of the monopoly of the state-controlled Telebras system to private competition, but the government, until now, has failed to come up with enabling legislation.
